name: Idaho
agency: Idaho Department of Parks and Recreation

rule.textEn: Idaho has no general boater education requirement. Education is only mandatory for PWC renters (given by the rental business) and for operators convicted of BUI or repeat boating violations.
rule.textEs: Idaho no tiene un requisito general de educación náutica. Solo es obligatoria para quien alquila una moto acuática (la imparte el negocio de alquiler) y para quienes son condenados por manejar bajo los efectos del alcohol o por infracciones náuticas repetidas.

minAge.note: No statewide minimum operating age; some counties (e.g. Benewah, Bonner, Kootenai) set local age rules.

card.feeNote: IDPR offers free in-person classes and a free home-study guide and test; approved online vendors may charge.

rental: PWC rental businesses must educate every renter who will operate the PWC; the operator carries a verification wallet card.
penalty: A course is ordered after a BUI conviction or repeat boating-law violations.

sources.publisher: Idaho Department of Parks and Recreation, Handbook of Idaho Boating Laws and Responsibilities (2021 ed., Wayback Machine copy of 2026-01-25)
sources.quote: Although there is no statewide law specifying a minimum age to operate a vessel, all operators must be competent and are held responsible for knowing the navigation rules.

sources.publisher: Idaho Department of Parks and Recreation, Handbook of Idaho Boating Laws and Responsibilities (2021 ed., Wayback Machine copy of 2026-01-25)
sources.quote: Idaho law requires boater education under these conditions.

sources.publisher: Idaho Department of Parks and Recreation, Handbook of Idaho Boating Laws and Responsibilities (2021 ed., Wayback Machine copy of 2026-01-25)
sources.quote: PWC rental businesses must provide education to each person who will ride and operate the PWC. The operator of the PWC must carry a verification wallet card.

sources.publisher: Idaho Department of Parks and Recreation, Handbook of Idaho Boating Laws and Responsibilities (2021 ed., Wayback Machine copy of 2026-01-25)
sources.quote: boat operators are required to pass a boating course if they are convicted of operating under the influence of drugs or alcohol.

sources.publisher: Idaho Department of Parks and Recreation, Handbook of Idaho Boating Laws and Responsibilities (2021 ed., Wayback Machine copy of 2026-01-25)
sources.quote: Boat operators who are repeat offenders of any boating law or rule also are required to pass a boating course.
